title: Fat grips training for forearm hypertrophy
summary: Answering a subscriber, NH explains how fat grips work and how to use them for forearm hypertrophy, while admitting he doesn't currently train with them. They thicken the bar, forcing an open-hand grip that taxes the forearms more; use them on curls (especially hammer curls) and pulls, but they complement rather than replace dedicated wrist and elbow flexion work. He'd add them if his forearms stall before his 15-inch goal.

claims.claim: He does not train with fat grips and has no plans to yet; his forearm training is going another direction, so this is a beta take to be updated later.
Fat grips are rubber sleeves that thicken a bar or dumbbell; strongman competitors can use them to simulate thick implements in a gym that lacks them.
Training with a thicker grip improves grip strength so a normal bar feels easier afterward.
He won't comment on claims that fat grips improve gains on presses since he has no experience with that.
A closed grip with the thumb wrapped over the fingers is always stronger; thinner bars are easier to grip, while thick bars force a weaker open-hand grip that taxes the forearm more.
Use fat grips on hammer curls, which already tax the forearm, on regular curls for extra biceps work, and on pulls from a rack in case the bar slips.
Isometric holds, deadlifts and rows alone aren't enough for forearms, and adding fat grips to those same movements still isn't enough; also do wrist flexion and elbow flexion work.
Program fat grip work like forearm work: on days with little upper arm work, such as lower body days, so fried grip doesn't hurt your curls and arm training.
He likes to do grip accessories such as grippers on lower body days.
He doesn't know anyone who built big forearms using fat grips.
The more effort you put in, the more you get back if you're smart about it; slapping fat grips on curls and calling it forearm work is lazy minimalism.
Fat grips complement forearm work rather than replacing it.
His goal is 15-inch forearms; he'll add fat grips if he stalls or after reaching that.
